description: "Sermons on the Card and Other Discourses" by Hugh Latimer is a collection of sermons from the early 16th century. Latimer, who emerged as a significant figure in the English Reformation, uses his eloquence to tackle moral and spiritual issues, guiding his audience toward the tenets of Christian duty with simplicity and earnestness.
